statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient has diagnosis code G45.9 (transient ischemic attack)
The patient has diagnosis code I48.0 (paroxysmal atrial fibrillation)
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitoring study) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The service is clinically indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes
This level of monitoring is necessary to detect intermittent arrhythmias that less intensive options may miss
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
